---
title: "Random Topic Generator"
description: "Generate a random topic from the Ideabank"
---

```{=html}
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html><body>

<style>
  .picker-controls {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: center;
    margin: 1.5rem 0;
  }
  .picker-controls button {
    padding: 0.9rem 2.2rem;
    font-size: 1.15rem;
    border-radius: 999px;
    cursor: pointer;
  }
</style>

<div class="picker-controls">
  <button id="roll" class="btn btn-primary">🎲 Generate a random topic</button>
</div>

<div id="result" style="margin-top:1.5rem"></div>

<script>
let ideas = [];

// HTML of an <li> excluding its nested list
function ownHTML(li) {
  const c = li.cloneNode(true);
  c.querySelectorAll("ul").forEach(u => u.remove());
  return c.innerHTML.trim();
}

async function loadIdeas() {
  const res = await fetch("ideabank.html", { cache: "no-store" });
  const doc = new DOMParser().parseFromString(await res.text(), "text/html");

  doc.querySelectorAll("section.level3").forEach(sec => {
    const category = sec.querySelector(":scope > h3")?.textContent.trim();
    const ul = sec.querySelector(":scope > ul");
    if (!category || !ul) return;

    ul.querySelectorAll(":scope > li").forEach(li => {
      if (li.querySelector("del, s")) return;        // skip crossed-out (done) items
      const subUl = li.querySelector(":scope > ul");
      ideas.push({
        category,
        html: ownHTML(li),
        subHTML: subUl ? subUl.outerHTML : ""
      });
    });
  });
}

function show(idea, save = true) {
  document.getElementById("result").innerHTML = `
    <h3>${idea.category}</h3>
    <p><strong>${idea.html}</strong></p>
    ${idea.subHTML}`;
  if (save) {
    try { localStorage.setItem("lastPick", JSON.stringify({ idea })); } catch {}
  }
}

// Restore the last pick when the page loads
try {
  const saved = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem("lastPick"));
  if (saved) show(saved.idea, false);
} catch {}

const pick = arr => arr[Math.floor(Math.random() * arr.length)];

document.getElementById("roll").onclick = async () => {
  if (!ideas.length) await loadIdeas();
  show(pick(ideas));
};
</script>

</body></html>
```
